newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel diffs strengthen, NYMEX near flat.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel diffs strengthen, NYMEX near flat.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials firmed modestly Friday, while NYMEX futures price levels remained near steady.

New York Harbor prompt 54-grade barrels rallied early in the day, with offers rising to 3.25 cents over the NYMEX print, up 0.50 cent on the day. However, those offers dipped back to about 3.00 cents over the print by mid-afternoon.

U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for back 9th cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline inched higher, with traders confirming deals done at 0.40 and 0.50 cent over the screen, a gain of 0.10 to 0.15 cent from Thursday.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
